snapshot-generation/ — the official FHIR snapshot-generation test corpus, vendored verbatim from
https://github.com/FHIR/fhir-test-cases  rX/snapshot-generation  (Apache-2.0), retrieved
2026-08-24. Each case is a StructureDefinition differential (`<name>-input.*`) plus the reference
implementation's generated snapshot (`<name>-output.*`); manifest.xml lists the cases.

SCOPE. This repo is JSON-only (no XML, documented repo-wide), so only cases whose INPUT and
OUTPUT are both JSON are executable here:
  * StructureDefinition-encounter-legalStatus  (Extension profile; -output.json is the R5-shaped
    snapshot, -output-4.0.1.json the R4 one — we compare against the R5 output since
    conformance/sd-index.rkt resolves bases from the R5 core package)
  * prov-fi                                    (Provenance profile, 91 differential elements ->
                                                270 snapshot elements)
The remaining cases have XML inputs and/or XML outputs and are SKIPPED — reported as such by the
harness rather than silently dropped. Several also profile IG bases (US Core, QICore, nl-core,
ch-*) that our R5-core-only resolver cannot reach; those would fail open regardless.

Run by conformance/tests/snapshot-conformance-test.rkt with a ratcheted floor.
